goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann erwartete Einnahmen, Ausgaben und Sparziele in einem einfachen Haushaltsbudget planen und mithilfe einer Tabellenkalkulation auswerten.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: An over-shoulder planner sees a simple spreadsheet with income, expenses and saving rows. Conceptual incoming resources lead to ordinary cost categories and a bicycle saving goal with a separate reserve, supported by a planning calendar; no fabricated arithmetic or infinite-money loop appears.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px the spreadsheet's three main row labels, living-cost groups, bicycle jar and reserve remain recognisable; small desk checklist is supplementary.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px incoming-resource allocation, expense categories, saving goal and reserve are clearly separated.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The laptop display faces the planner in an over-shoulder view. The angled checklist is on the planner's accessible side and has a plausible reading orientation from that seat; no upside-down actor-facing required text is shown.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: Arrows are qualitative planned allocations; no fixed savings surplus or numeric budget balance is asserted. The reserve can be part of planned savings, not additional income.
